{{Recipe summary
| Category = Recipes for dessert
| Yield = 12 pastries
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 400 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] frozen [[Cookbook:Puff Pastry|puff pastry]], thawed
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]]
* 1 cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] [[Cookbook:Zest|zest]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|icing sugar]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 425°F (220°C).
# [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll]] half the dough out to 14×10-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] rectangle. Use a 4 ½-inch round [[Cookbook:Cookie Cutter|cookie cutter]] to out circles.
# Press the dough circles into 12 [[Cookbook:Muffin Pan|muffin cups]]. Line each with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]], then fill with [[Cookbook:Pie Weights|pie weights]]. Freeze about 15 minutes.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] pastry shells in bottom third of oven for 10 minutes. Remove foil and weights; let cool for 10 minutes.
# Meanwhile, in microwaveable bowl, [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] together cream, flour, egg yolks, sugar, and lemon zest. [[Cookbook:Microwave Cooking|Microwave]] at medium for about 8 minutes, or until it reaches the consistency of pudding, whisking every minute or so.
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] pudding into bowl; let cool for 5 minutes.
# Pour pudding into shells. [[Cookbook:Broiling|Broil]] 6 inches from the heat source for 3 minutes. Let cool on rack for 15 minutes
# Remove pastries from pan, and refrigerate for about 4 hours.
# Sprinkle with icing sugar and serve.

recipe.name: Lemon Custard Pastry Cups (Pastel de Nada)

steps.text: Roll half the dough out to 14×10-inch rectangle. Use a 4 ½-inch round cookie cutter to out circles.
Press the dough circles into 12 muffin cups. Line each with foil, then fill with pie weights. Freeze about 15 minutes.
Bake pastry shells in bottom third of oven for 10 minutes. Remove foil and weights; let cool for 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, in microwaveable bowl, whisk together cream, flour, egg yolks, sugar, and lemon zest. Microwave at medium for about 8 minutes, or until it reaches the consistency of pudding, whisking every minute or so.
Strain pudding into bowl; let cool for 5 minutes.
Pour pudding into shells. Broil 6 inches from the heat source for 3 minutes. Let cool on rack for 15 minutes
Remove pastries from pan, and refrigerate for about 4 hours.
Sprinkle with icing sugar and serve.
